messages:
leigh-people-ops: Quick update 1 1 We finalized the Compassionate & Bereavement Leave wording for the handbook and are rolling a 30-day grace-period pilot for documentation/support. Managers: please review the manager checklist and confirm by EOD Thu. Handbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/Compassionate+Leave

viv-payroll: Thanks Leigh. Two payroll items: 1) Is leave paid or unpaid in the pilot? 2) Which payroll code do we use for reporting?

leigh-people-ops: Pilot terms: up to 2 weeks fully paid for immediate family bereavement, up to 4 additional weeks unpaid with manager approval. Payroll code: BEREV. I'll add the CSV example to the ops checklist.

hiro-legal: For EU/UK: added required consultation language and recordkeeping notes. Also added guidance on statutory bereavement pay interactions for UK staff. Pushed a legal diff to the Confluence page.

cassie-people-manager: Manager practical Q: if an IC needs documentation (e.g., death certificate) but it's delayed, is there temporary accommodation? Also what about international time zones for real-time support?

leigh-people-ops: Good Q. Temp accommodation: managers can approve up to 7 days pending docs; HR will follow up for records. For time zones, we have 24/7 People Ops escalation via the oncall rota; I'll add the escalation link to the checklist.

ana-emea: Note for EMEA managers: for DE/FR were coordinating localized language with regional counsel. Please do not auto-apply the pilot in EMEA until local addenda are posted. I'll flag teams that should wait.

viv-payroll: Sample CSV well use for the initial feed: ```
employee_id,leave_start,leave_end,pay_code,pay_pct
99876,2026-06-01,2026-06-14,BEREV,100
```

ack-bot: Assigned microlearning "Compassionate & Bereavement Leave: Manager Brief" to managers. Due: 2026-05-10. Tracking: https://training.redwood.com/assignments/bereavement-2026

leigh-people-ops: Action items (brief): 1) Managers: review checklist + sign off, 2) Payroll: add BEREV code to mapping and send sample export, 3) Legal: finalize EMEA addenda, 4) People Ops: publish FAQ and escalation matrix. Ill compile a weekly status in #people-ops.

cassie-people-manager: Thanks 64F I'll review with my direct reports and complete the ack. Where does the manager sign-off live?

search-bot: Manager sign-off form created: https://hr-internal.redwood.com/forms/manager-signoff/bereavement-2026

viv-payroll: :thumbsup: Will upload mapping and sample export by Monday and confirm with Leigh.

hiro-legal: Noted. I'll post the EMEA addenda draft by Friday and list any document retention requirements.

leigh-people-ops: Great team, thanks. Ill follow up with a brief lunch-and-learn invite next week for managers who want a walkthrough. :sparkles:
